title: OpusClip Playbook: 4 OpusClip workflows that actually work
caption:
4 OpusClip workflows that actually work

This is what worked. Steal the system:
1️⃣ Paste one link — YouTube, Zoom, or a webinar recording — no re-editing, no timeline scrubbing, no editor.
2️⃣ It finds the hooks — 10–40 vertical clips cut automatically, each captioned word-by-word for silent scrollers.
3️⃣ Post the top 3 — Every clip gets a virality score — ship the highest first, queue the rest across the week.
4️⃣ Stack the week — One 60-minute recording covers a month of daily shorts. Record once, publish for 30 days.

Try it and tell me what happens.
